one_liner: Open-source command-line tool that renders Mermaid diagram definitions into SVG/PNG/PDF files.

auth.evidence_quote: This is a command-line interface (CLI) for mermaid. It takes a mermaid definition file as input and generates an SVG/PNG/PDF file as output.
auth.notes: Purely local CLI tool; no accounts, no hosted service, no auth of any kind.

access.notes: Free, open-source (MIT-style), installable via npm with no signup required.

api.notes: No hosted API; it's a local binary (mmdc) invoked via shell. No official or community MCP server found specific to mermaid-cli.

verdict.rationale: It is a free, open-source local CLI tool with no hosted API or auth, so an agent toolkit would shell out to it locally rather than call a remote API.
